answer: Cosignatures are collected in inlet, verified in pigment, and falcon names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 3 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 36 submissions per epoch. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Repeating the trick 8 times costs 33 separate deposits and 26 separate proofs of work. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
